definition_of_done.behavior_outcome: A service started on a reachable host:port persists sessions and session messages on disk.
acceptance_checks: Connect creates or updates a session.
Message posts are persisted under the session id.
definition_of_done.rollback_or_fallback: Remove the new package if the service contract proves incorrect.
definition_of_done.verifier_acceptance_condition: Reviewer confirms only minimal session/message behavior was added.

acceptance_checks: send resolves the current session from local state when omitted
read returns persisted messages from the service
